editor.close.after_send.description: Editor's notification on closing it while the saved file is still being sent to its server (SFTP, cloud).
editor.close.after_send.message: It closes once the server has it.

editor.close.discard.description: Button of the Save changes dialog: closes without saving. Keep it short.

editor.close.save.description: Button of the Save changes dialog: saves, then closes. Keep it short.

editor.close.title.description: Title of the dialog shown on closing the editor with unsaved changes.

editor.close.unsaved.description: Text of the dialog shown on closing the editor with unsaved changes. {name} is the file's name (e.g. notes.txt).
editor.close.unsaved.message: {name} has changes that are not saved.

editor.close.unsent.description: Text of the dialog shown on closing the editor while a file from a server (SFTP, cloud) is saved here but could not be sent back. {name} is the file's name (e.g. notes.txt).
editor.close.unsent.message: {name} is not saved on its server: sending it failed.

editor.dialog.cancel.description: Cancel button of the editor's dialogs (Reload, Save it as text, Save changes). Keep it short.

editor.edit.copy.description: Editor › Edit menu item. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.edit.cut.description: Editor › Edit menu item. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.edit.find.description: Editor › Edit menu item: opens the find bar. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.edit.find_next.description: Editor › Edit menu item. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.edit.find_previous.description: Editor › Edit menu item. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.edit.go_to_line.description: Editor › Edit menu item: asks for a line number to jump to. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.edit.paste.description: Editor › Edit menu item. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.edit.redo.description: Editor › Edit menu item. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.edit.replace.description: Editor › Edit menu item: opens the find bar with replacing. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.edit.undo.description: Editor › Edit menu item. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.external.not_set.description: Error shown after the file's name ("notes.txt: …") when Ctrl+Shift+F4 has no external editor to start; starts in lower case. "Settings, Edit/View" names the Settings page as it is called there.
editor.external.not_set.message: no external editor is set (Settings, Edit/View)

editor.file.close.description: Editor › File menu item: closes the editor's window. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.file.reload.description: Editor › File menu item: reads the file again from the disk. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.file.save.description: Editor › File menu item: saves the file. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.file.save_as.description: Editor › File menu item: saves the text to another file. Keep it short; "..." means a dialog opens.

editor.find.close.description: Editor's find bar (as VS Code's, top right of the text): tooltip of the button that closes the find bar. The key name in brackets stays as it is.

editor.find.count.description: Editor's find bar: which match is selected of how many, as VS Code's. {current} is a number or ? (none selected), {total} a number or 20000+ (e.g. 3 of 12). Very little room: keep it short.

editor.find.in_selection.description: Editor's find bar (as VS Code's, top right of the text): tooltip of the toggle that searches only the selected text. The key name in brackets stays as it is.

editor.find.match_case.description: Editor's find bar (as VS Code's, top right of the text): tooltip of the toggle that finds only the same upper and lower case. The key name in brackets stays as it is.

editor.find.next.description: Editor's find bar (as VS Code's, top right of the text): tooltip of the button that selects the next match. The key name in brackets stays as it is.

editor.find.no_results.description: Editor's find bar: nothing matches the searched text. Very little room: keep it short.

editor.find.placeholder.description: Editor's find bar: placeholder of the field for the text to find. Keep it short.

editor.find.preserve_case.description: Editor's find bar (as VS Code's, top right of the text): tooltip of the toggle that keeps the replaced text's upper and lower case. The key name in brackets stays as it is.

editor.find.previous.description: Editor's find bar (as VS Code's, top right of the text): tooltip of the button that selects the previous match. The key name in brackets stays as it is.

editor.find.regex.description: Editor's find bar (as VS Code's, top right of the text): tooltip of the toggle that reads the searched text as a regular expression. The key name in brackets stays as it is.

editor.find.replace.description: Editor's find bar (as VS Code's, top right of the text): tooltip of the button that replaces the selected match. The key name in brackets stays as it is.

editor.find.replace_all.description: Editor's find bar (as VS Code's, top right of the text): tooltip of the button that replaces every match. The key name in brackets stays as it is.

editor.find.replace_placeholder.description: Editor's find bar: placeholder of the field for the text to replace it with. Keep it short.

editor.find.toggle_replace.description: Editor's find bar: tooltip of the arrow that shows or hides the replace field.

editor.find.whole_word.description: Editor's find bar (as VS Code's, top right of the text): tooltip of the toggle that finds whole words only. The key name in brackets stays as it is.

editor.go_to_line.label.description: Label of the field in the Go to Line dialog: a line number, or line and column as 12:5. Keep the line:column form understandable.

editor.go_to_line.title.description: Title of the dialog Edit › Go to line opens.

editor.language.by_file_name.description: Editor › Language menu item, ticked while on: the text is coloured by the language its file name (extension) says. Keep it short.

editor.language.plain_text.description: Editor › Language menu item and status bar: text with no syntax colouring. Keep it short.

editor.menu.edit.description: Editor window's menu bar (F4's built-in text editor): the Edit menu. Keep it short.

editor.menu.file.description: Editor window's menu bar (F4's built-in text editor): the File menu. Keep it short.

editor.menu.language.description: Editor window's menu bar (F4's built-in text editor): the Language menu, which chooses the programming language the text is coloured as (syntax highlighting). Keep it short.

editor.menu.selection.description: Editor window's menu bar (F4's built-in text editor): the Selection menu. Keep it short.

editor.menu.view.description: Editor window's menu bar (F4's built-in text editor): the View menu. Keep it short.

editor.open.too_large.description: Error shown after the file's name ("notes.log: …") when the file is too large for the built-in editor; starts in lower case. {limit_mb} is the limit in megabytes (e.g. 32). "Settings, Edit/View" names the Settings page as it is called there; Ctrl+Shift+F4 stays as it is.
editor.open.too_large.message: over the built-in editor's {limit_mb} MB (Settings, Edit/View); Ctrl+Shift+F4 edits it in the external one

editor.reload.button.description: Button of the Reload dialog: reads the file again, losing the changes. Keep it short.

editor.reload.failed.description: Editor's error notification: the file could not be read again. {err} is the system's error text (e.g. No such file or directory).

editor.reload.text.description: Text of the dialog File › Reload opens while the text has unsaved changes.
editor.reload.text.message: The changes that are not saved are lost.

editor.reload.title.description: Title of the dialog File › Reload opens while the text has unsaved changes.

editor.reload.unfit.description: Editor's error notification: the file changed on the disk into something that is not text, so it was not read again. {why} is one of: binary (the file holds zero bytes) or other (it is not UTF-8 text); translate the words inside each branch only.
editor.reload.unfit.message: Not reloaded: {why, select, binary {it is binary} other {it is not UTF-8 text}}.

editor.save.admin.description: What the system refused, as the start of a dialog's text that goes on ": permission denied. As administrator, the system asks for the password.". {name} is the file's name (e.g. hosts).

editor.save.failed.description: Editor's error notification. {path} is the file's full path (e.g. /etc/fstab); {err} is the system's error text (e.g. Permission denied).

editor.save_anyway.button.description: Button of the Save it as text dialog: saves the file as shown. Keep it short.

editor.save_anyway.text.description: Text of the dialog shown on saving a file that was not text (binary, or not UTF-8) but opened as text anyway.
editor.save_anyway.text.message: The file was not text: saving writes it as shown, so whatever was not text changes for good.

editor.save_anyway.title.description: Title of the dialog shown on saving a file that was not text but opened as text anyway.

editor.selection.add_cursor_above.description: Editor › Selection menu item: another text cursor on the line above, for typing in several places at once. Keep it short.

editor.selection.add_cursor_below.description: Editor › Selection menu item: another text cursor on the line below. Keep it short.

editor.selection.delete_lines.description: Editor › Selection menu item. Keep it short.

editor.selection.duplicate_lines.description: Editor › Selection menu item: copies the selected lines below themselves. Keep it short.

editor.selection.indent.description: Editor › Selection menu item: moves the selected lines right by one indent. Keep it short.

editor.selection.lowercase.description: Editor › Selection menu item: turns the selected text to lower case; written in lower case itself. Keep it short.

editor.selection.move_lines_down.description: Editor › Selection menu item. Keep it short.

editor.selection.move_lines_up.description: Editor › Selection menu item. Keep it short.

editor.selection.outdent.description: Editor › Selection menu item: moves the selected lines left by one indent. Keep it short.

editor.selection.select_all.description: Editor › Selection menu item. Keep it short.

editor.selection.select_all_occurrences.description: Editor › Selection menu item: selects every place of the searched text (or the word at the cursor) to edit them at once. Keep it short.

editor.selection.sort_lines_ascending.description: Editor › Selection menu item: sorts the selected lines A to Z. Keep it short.

editor.selection.sort_lines_descending.description: Editor › Selection menu item: sorts the selected lines Z to A. Keep it short.

editor.selection.title_case.description: Editor › Selection menu item: capitalizes each word of the selected text; written that way itself. Keep it short.

editor.selection.toggle_line_comment.description: Editor › Selection menu item: comments the selected lines out in the program's language (// or #), or back in. Keep it short.

editor.selection.trim_trailing_whitespac.description: Editor › Selection menu item: removes spaces and tabs at the lines' ends. Keep it short.

editor.selection.uppercase.description: Editor › Selection menu item: turns the selected text to upper case; written in upper case itself, as in VS Code. Keep it short.

editor.send.failed.description: Editor's error notification: a file opened from a server (SFTP, cloud) was saved here but could not be sent back to the server. {err} is the error text (e.g. Connection refused).
editor.send.failed.message: Could not save it back: {err}. Save tries again.

editor.status.modified.description: Editor's status bar, under the text: the text has unsaved changes. Keep it short.

editor.status.position.description: Editor's status bar, under the text: where the text cursor is, as VS Code's (Ln = line, Col = column). {line} and {column} are numbers, e.g. 12 and 5. Keep it short.

editor.status.position_selected.description: Editor's status bar, under the text: where the text cursor is, as VS Code's (Ln = line, Col = column), and how many characters are selected. {line} and {column} are numbers, e.g. 12 and 5; {count} is the number of selected characters. Keep it short.
editor.status.position_selected.message: Ln {line}, Col {column} ({count, plural, one {# selected} other {# selected}})

editor.status.sending.description: Editor's status bar, under the text: the saved file is being sent back to its server (SFTP, cloud). Keep it short.

editor.status.spaces.description: Editor's status bar, under the text: the text is indented with spaces, {size} of them per level (e.g. 4). Keep it short.

editor.status.tab_size.description: Editor's status bar, under the text: the text is indented with tabs, each {size} columns wide (e.g. 4). Keep it short.

editor.status.unsent.description: Editor's status bar, under the text: the file is saved here, but sending it back to its server failed. Keep it short.

editor.terminal.not_found.description: scmd (the terminal app): error shown after the file's name ("notes.txt: …") when F4 finds no terminal editor (nano, vi); starts in lower case. $EDITOR is an environment variable's name: keep it.

editor.title.description: Title of the editor's window. {path} is the edited file's full path (e.g. /home/anna/notes.txt); a * goes before it while there are unsaved changes.

editor.unfit.open_anyway.description: Button under the editor's warning that the file is not text: shows it as text anyway. Keep it short.

editor.unfit.text.description: Shown in the editor's window instead of the text when editing it as text could change the file by accident. {why} is one of: binary (the file holds zero bytes) or other (it is not UTF-8 text); translate the words inside each branch only.
editor.unfit.text.message: The file is not shown in the editor because {why, select, binary {it is binary} other {it is not UTF-8 text}}.

editor.view.folding.description: Editor › View menu item, ticked while on: blocks of code can be folded away. Keep it short.

editor.view.indent_guides.description: Editor › View menu item, ticked while on: vertical lines at each indent level. Keep it short.

editor.view.indent_with_tabs.description: Editor › View menu item, ticked while on: indent with tab characters instead of spaces. Keep it short.

editor.view.line_numbers.description: Editor › View menu item, ticked while on. Keep it short.

editor.view.minimap.description: Editor › View menu item, ticked while on: the small overview of the whole text at the right. Keep it short.

editor.view.tab_width.description: Editor › View menu item, ticked while on: the columns a tab is wide. {width} is 2, 4 or 8. Keep it short.

editor.view.unfold_all.description: Editor › View menu item: opens every folded block. Keep it short.

editor.view.whitespace.description: Editor › View menu item, ticked while on: spaces and tabs shown as marks. Keep it short.

editor.view.word_wrap.description: Editor › View menu item, ticked while on: long lines wrap at the window's edge. Keep it short.
